final_archive_confidentiality_note: The reset archive carries provider credentials, session databases, an env file, the owner's mode-600 ledgers and the trade-secret corpus. It is NOT encrypted. Mode 0600 is a filesystem permission and is NOT encryption: anyone with root on the host, or with access to the cloud account it is copied to, can read it. Its confidentiality rests entirely on filesystem and cloud access controls. RESET_PRIVATE_INCLUDE.tsv names every sensitive path carried on purpose; scripts/lib/archive-guard.sh is NOT weakened to permit them -- its local-authorized mode already models this case and requires the naming.
head_semantics: manifest_generated_from_head is the revision these manifests were measured against and is necessarily the parent of the commit that carries them; current_measured_head is read live; final_archive_head is written by the archive step and is null until the archive exists.
